thread:
samir: Hey team — opened a tiny PR to update the JS quickstart to use the streaming API. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/428  Can someone spare ~10m to review? Changes: auth snippet, await for stream, small note about max_tokens.

maya: On my list, will look right after standup.

ken: Quick heads-up — preview build failed on Netlify: https://app.netlify.com/sites/deploy-preview-428/logs. Error looks like a missing import in the example snippet (`Client` vs `RedwoodClient`). @ci-bot can you re-run?

ci-bot: Re-run queued by ken — build started (job 98765).

jules: I left two inline comments: 1) prefer `await stream.toString()` -> actually show consuming example with `for await (const chunk of stream)` for clarity; 2) clarify that the token limit in the snippet is illustrative. Also suggest adding a one-line backwards compatibility note for teams on older SDKs.

maya: Pushed a tiny fix for the import and added the `for await` example. Also added the one-liner about SDK versioning. Local preview looks good.

samir: Awesome — thanks. Can someone approve so I can merge before EOD? Need 1 approval.

lina: Approved, LGTM :thumbsup:

ken: Approved as well, looks good to me.

samir: Merged and deployed the preview: https://deploy-preview-428--docs.redwood.ai/ . Thanks y'all!

maya: Nice, I'll follow up with a short note in the release checklist to remind about streaming examples for future quickstarts.

jules: Thanks for the quick turnaround :rocket:
